purpose: Durable synthetic benchmark observations, plans, worker outcomes, logs and source manifests.
redaction: Machine-specific absolute path prefixes replaced by <machine-path>; numeric observations, ordering and outcomes unchanged. Member hashes retain original and published identities. Archived source scripts are provenance copies, not supported execution commands.

semantic_supplement.scope: Separate non-timing fixture; does not retroactively expand the old 400-epoch oracle.

semantic_application_source.scope: Published tracked repository source only; no production configuration or vendor bundle.
